capabilities: Create Rentry pastes from vault notes via command palette or file context menu
Update and remove existing pastes with one-way sync towards Rentry
Track paste state through frontmatter properties like rentryId and rentryEditCode
extras: Cloudinary image uploads are marked experimental and need credentials; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish individual notes to Rentry or keep those pastes in sync with the vault.

relations.evidence: Share your vault notes using Rentry
Image embed uploads via Cloudinary (experimental, requires credentials.

summary: Publishing plugin that shares vault notes as pastes on Rentry, with paste updating, removal, and optional image uploads via Cloudinary.
